heading: The tick's cost
text:
### The tick's cost [LDTL.6.3]

- Without `dynamic_ttl`, the TTL tick is **O(expired × log n_ttl_schemas +
  n_ttl_schemas)**: it merges the fronts of the per-schema queues
  ([LDTL.3.1]). No term grows with N_ttl. Each expiry decision is O(1): one
  comparison of a queue front's deadline ([LDTL.1.1]) with the tick's
  instant. No heap allocation is made anywhere in the TTL path.
- With `dynamic_ttl`, the TTL tick is **O(expired × log N_ttl)**: it drains
  the deadline heap ([LDTL.4.2]).
